turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going from the city to the coast for a long weekend and I can't settle on how.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A direct coach leaves at seven in the morning, it's cheap but takes nearly five hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's the fast train, about two and a half hours, but tickets are three times the price.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A slower regional train is in between on price and goes along the river, which is supposed to be beautiful.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If it's a relaxing weekend, I'd pick the river train, it's reasonably priced and you get the views. Book the fast train only if you're arriving late Friday and every hour counts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I want to start a little film club with my neighbours. How do I make it not awkward?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it simple at first. Same night every month, someone's living room, and one film everyone agrees on in advance.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rotate it. Each host picks, which gives everyone a turn and mixes up the genres.
